decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit fits the firm's core injection and plural-component business, had its own page through 2019, and shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
This injection unit kept its own page and serves the construction and repair customer base, so a medium firm with established slack would continue carrying it.
Automatic airless guns are a staple accessory with recurring spare-parts revenue, and the product stayed consistently presented, indicating performance at or above aspiration.
Manual airless guns are core consumable-like products tied to the installed pump base, so dropping one would sacrifice dependable results without good reason.
The air-assisted airless gun line with several models is an established family that complements the firm's equipment, and nothing in its web presence signals underperformance.

The data logger went from its own page to a mere mention in 2019, suggesting results below aspiration, but as a low-cost digital add-on supporting the firm's innovation direction it can likely be carried on slack for now.
